description: PARTIAL SAVE: writes ONLY the 'Currency' field of TitlePublicConfigurationModel; all other v1/v2 fields stay untouched. Currency catalogue: VirtualCurrencies (Gold, Gems, Energy, etc.) AND CryptoCurrencies (on-chain tokens). Defines IDs, economy (USD value, balance limits), recharge rules for energy-like currencies, conversion rules, and per-currency permissions. The CurrencyID of each entry is referenced by Item prices, Store SKUs, Reward payouts, Quest rewards, Lootbox loot, etc. NOTE: the "Main" CryptoCurrency entry is protected and cannot be overwritten — your changes to that key will be silently ignored.

x-enum-descriptions: Rate is computed automatically from ValueInUSD of source and target currencies.
Rate is taken manually from ConversionTarget.Rate per pair.

DailyLimit.description: Per-player daily limit for conversions on this specific pair (in source currency units). Null means no limit. Counted by UTC days.

MaxAmount.description: Maximum source amount per conversion operation. Null means no limit. Protects against single-shot balance drains.

MinAmount.description: Minimum source amount per conversion operation. Null means no limit. Prevents dust conversions that round to 0 target.

Rate.description: Fixed conversion rate: units of target per 1 unit of source. Used only when Conversion.RateMode = Manual; ignored under Automatic.

TargetCurrencyID.description: CurrencyID of the target currency the conversion is allowed to.

TargetCurrencyType.description: Type of target currency. Determines which dictionary to resolve TargetCurrencyID against (virtual or crypto). Required.

AssetPaths.description: Paths to currency assets (icons, network logos, animations). Element purpose is defined by client convention.

Audit.description: Record metadata: creation and last-modified times. Shared type with virtual currencies.

CommunityMarketingWithdrawalFeePercent.description: Community Marketing fee (percent) on a PLAYER withdrawal of this currency: that share of the withdrawn amount funds the Community Marketing pool (rewards for promoting the game on social media). Developer fee + Community Marketing fee + burn must not exceed 50%.

Conversion.description: Conversion rules for this currency. Targets can be other crypto or virtual currencies (distinguished by ConversionTarget.TargetCurrencyType). Null means fully disabled.

CurrencyID.description: Unique stable crypto-currency identifier (e.g. "BTC", "ETH", "USDT"). Primary key used across balance operations, analytics, and references. Immutable after creation.

DeveloperWithdrawalFeePercent.description: Developer fee (percent) on a PLAYER withdrawal of this currency: that share of the withdrawn amount moves to the developer's share of the title pool. Deposits are credited to the player in full; crypto the player spends in-game also goes to the developer. Developer fee + Community Marketing fee + burn must not exceed 50%.

DisplayDecimals.description: Number of decimals to show in UI and accept on user input. Presentational only; on-chain decimals per token+network are in CryptoNetworkBinding.Decimals.

DisplayName.description: Display name for internal use (admin panel, logs). Player-facing localization is handled separately by CurrencyID key.

Limits.description: Compliance limits (AML/KYC). Separate from Permissions because this is regulatory. Null means no limits set (usually dev/testnet only).

Networks.description: Currency-to-network bindings: which networks the currency lives in, with per-network parameters (contract address, on-chain decimals, minimums, fee).

Permissions.description: Behavioral flags: what can be done with the currency (deposits, withdrawals, in-game spend, conversion to virtual).

PlayerTradeFeePercent.description: Developer fee (percent) on PLAYER-TO-PLAYER trades in this currency: a marketplace sale, a PvP win, a purchase from a Workshop author. The seller/winner receives the amount minus this fee; the fee moves to the developer's share of the title pool. One value for every trading module. Max 50%. In-game prices are not affected — spent crypto already goes to the developer in full.

ServerGrantPolicy.description: Daily caps on rewards of this currency (everything but deposits): module rewards (quests, events, season, store, lootboxes, IAP products...), an AI feature Reward and CloudCode's server.ApplyResourceOperation. Rewards are always paid in crypto from the players' reward pool of this title (plus the developer's share if CryptoRewardsFromDeveloperShare is on); what the pool cannot cover, or what exceeds a cap, is granted as the IOU currency (UnbackedRewardCurrencyID). null = no caps. Editable for Main too. Mode matters only for CloudCode and AI rewards while CryptoIouForScriptsAndAI is off. Does not affect deposits, withdrawals or player spend.

Status.description: Current lifecycle status. Allows soft retirement without deleting the record so transaction history continues to reference CurrencyID.

UnbackedRewardCurrencyID.description: IOU virtual currency of this crypto: the part of a crypto reward that is not backed at grant time (by the players' reward pool, plus the developer's share if CryptoRewardsFromDeveloperShare is on) is granted in this virtual currency 1:1. The player sees crypto was owed; the developer repays it with real crypto from the dashboard. When the player spends this crypto in the game, the IOU is spent first. Must be a key of VirtualCurrencies. Not set — an unbacked reward is refused.

UsdPriceRefreshMinutes.description: Main token only: how often (minutes) the engine refreshes the token USD price on in-game crypto spends. Custom value needs a paid plan; default 720 (twice a day). Each refresh counts as an API call. 5..10080.

ValueInUSD.description: Cached USD value per unit (from oracle/exchange). Used for USD display, USD-limit/KYC checks, and BI. Not authoritative for real-time conversion — fetch live quote from price service.

ValueInUSDUpdatedAt.description: Timestamp of the last ValueInUSD update. Consumers can decide whether to use cached value or fetch a fresh quote.

WithdrawalBurnPercent.description: Percentage of a player token withdrawal that is BURNED on-chain (EVM: DEAD address, Solana: incinerator). The server binds the burn amount into the withdrawal signature. Developer fee + Community Marketing fee + burn must not exceed 50%; the platform's own withdrawal commission is separate.

ConvertibleToVirtual.description: Whether this currency can be converted to/from virtual currencies. False rejects targets with TargetCurrencyType=Virtual even if listed in Conversion.Targets.

DepositsEnabled.description: Global deposit switch for this currency (across all networks). For per-network control use CryptoNetworkBinding.DepositsEnabled.

SpendableInGame.description: Whether the currency can be spent in-game (store purchases, event bets). False restricts it to deposit/withdraw/convert only.

WithdrawalsEnabled.description: Global withdrawal switch for this currency. See DepositsEnabled.

DailyWithdrawUsd.description: Per-player daily withdrawal limit in USD equivalent. Null means no daily limit. AML-driven, USD-denominated for consistency across volatile currencies.

KycRequiredAboveUsd.description: USD-equivalent threshold for a single withdrawal above which KYC is required. Null means KYC not required for this currency.

MonthlyWithdrawUsd.description: Monthly withdrawal limit in USD equivalent. Separate from daily because KYC tiers typically have both. Null means no monthly limit.

ContractAddress.description: Token smart-contract address in this network (ERC-20/BEP-20/TRC-20). Null for native coins (ETH, BNB, TRX, BTC); distinguishes native transfer vs contract call.

Decimals.description: On-chain decimals for this token in this network. Used to convert whole units to/from smallest units in raw on-chain transactions. Distinct from DisplayDecimals.

DepositsEnabled.description: Deposit switch for this currency-network pair. Allows disabling one network during incidents without affecting others.

MinWithdraw.description: Minimum amount per withdrawal in this network. Enforced on the withdrawal path: a smaller amount is refused.

NetworkID.description: Network identifier from the title-level networks config (e.g. "ethereum", "bsc", "tron"). Network config itself lives elsewhere.

WithdrawalsEnabled.description: Withdrawal switch for this currency-network pair. Used to pause withdrawals on one network (e.g. drained hot-wallet) while others keep working.

x-enum-descriptions: Only for CloudCode and AI rewards while CryptoIouForScriptsAndAI is off: their crypto grants are refused. Default. Module rewards ignore the mode.

Only for CloudCode and AI rewards while CryptoIouForScriptsAndAI is off: in the SAME transaction the grant is paid from the players' reward pool, the rest from the developer's share if CryptoRewardsFromDeveloperShare is on. If that is short, the whole operation rolls back. Module rewards ignore the mode.

CryptoServerGrantPolicy.description: Server-issued grant policy for one crypto currency. See CryptoServerGrantMode.

FundingNetworkID.description: Which network (one of this currency's Networks) pays rewards from its pool. Not needed when the currency lives in one network — that one is used. Required when Mode = Backed.

PerPlayerDailyTokens.description: Per-player daily cap on crypto rewards, in whole tokens. null = no cap. Over the cap: see RefuseOverCap (IOU by default; CloudCode/AI without IOU: refused).

RefuseOverCap.description: What happens when a daily cap is reached. true = the reward is refused entirely with CRYPTO_SERVER_GRANT_CAP_EXCEEDED:{currency} (nothing is granted, not even an IOU). null/false = the reward is granted as the IOU currency.

TitleDailyTokens.description: Title-wide daily cap on crypto rewards, in whole tokens. null = no cap. Over the cap: see RefuseOverCap (IOU by default; CloudCode/AI without IOU: refused).

CreatedAt.description: Record creation time. Set once on insert and immutable thereafter.

UpdatedAt.description: Record last-modified time. Updated on every save. Used for audit and client cache invalidation.

Enabled.description: Master conversion switch. False disables conversion regardless of Targets content.

Fee.description: Conversion fee as a SHARE of the debited amount: 0.05 = 5% (the platform-wide unit, see RateSpec). Empty or 0 means no fee. Taken from the source currency BEFORE calculating the received amount. Deliberately NOT named FeePercent: the Percent suffix is banned platform-wide because it was the source of 0..1 vs 0..100 confusion.

RateMode.description: Rate calculation mode for this currency as conversion source. Automatic uses Economy.ValueInUSD; Manual uses per-pair ConversionTarget.Rate.

Targets.description: Whitelist of target currencies with conversion parameters. Null/empty means no conversion allowed. One-directional: a target listed here does not imply the reverse is allowed.

x-enum-descriptions: Available in all operations and shown to players.
Hidden in UI but operations are formally allowed (e.g. internal tests).
New earnings/purchases disabled; existing balance can still be spent.
All operations temporarily blocked (maintenance, emergency stop).

Max.description: Recharge cap: balance ceiling for auto-recharge. A batch is clipped exactly at this value (if less than Rate is missing, only the remainder is credited); at or above it nothing is credited. Above this, currency can only be gained via explicit grants. Distinct from the global cap in Economy.MaxBalance.

Period.description: Length of one recharge period in seconds. Units are credited on full-period boundaries measured from the last accrual or spend, not on a wall-clock grid.

Rate.description: Units credited per FULL period, granted as a single batch. Rate=5 with Period=60 means +5 once a minute, not +1 every 12 seconds: an incomplete period credits nothing and its time is carried over.

AssetPaths.description: Paths to currency assets (icons of various sizes, animated versions, SVG, etc.). Element purpose is defined by project convention on the client side.

Audit.description: Record metadata: creation and last modification times. Used for audit, incident investigation, and client cache invalidation.

Conversion.description: Rules for converting this currency to others. Null means conversion is fully disabled.

CurrencyID.description: Unique stable currency identifier (e.g. "GOLD", "GEMS", "ENERGY"). Primary key used in balance operations, analytics events, and cross-references from other entities. Immutable after creation.

DisplayName.description: Display name for internal use (admin panel, logs, tooling). Not intended for player-facing display; player localization is handled separately by CurrencyID key.

Economy.description: Economic parameters: USD value, initial deposit, balance limits, granularity. Describes the currency's value and storage bounds.

Permissions.description: Behavioral flags: what can be done with the currency (trade, purchase with real money, convert, refund).

Recharge.description: Auto-recharge configuration. Null means the currency does not self-recharge (gold, gems). When set, the currency behaves as an energy resource (hearts, moves, energy).

Status.description: Current lifecycle status of the currency. Allows soft retirement without deleting the record so transaction history continues to reference CurrencyID.

DailyEarnLimit.description: Max amount of currency a player can EARN per UTC day. Null means no limit.

DailySpendLimit.description: Max amount of currency a player can SPEND per UTC day. Null means no limit. Compliance mechanism for real-money currencies.

InitialDeposit.description: Amount of currency granted to a new player at account creation. 0 means none. Applied once during wallet initialization.

MaxBalance.description: Hard upper balance cap. Anti-exploit safeguard and global cap over Recharge.Max. long.MaxValue means effectively unlimited.

MinBalance.description: Minimum allowed balance. Usually 0; negative values are allowed for credit/penalty mechanics. Any debit that would breach this is rejected before balance change.

ValueInUSD.description: Base USD value per unit of currency. Used for cross-currency conversion equivalence, BI valuation of rewards/lootboxes, and store pricing via the multiplier.

ValueInUSDUpdatedAt.description: Timestamp when ValueInUSD was last updated. Consumers of the cached price can use it to decide whether to refresh the quote.

IsPurchasable.description: Whether the currency can be purchased with real money (IAP, storefront). Used when building storefronts and validating IAP callbacks.

IsRefundable.description: Whether the currency is refundable on IAP refunds and compensations. True by default; disable for derived currencies obtained by conversion.

IsTradable.description: Whether the currency can be transferred between players (gifts, P2P trade, guild bank). False by default.

value.description: New value for the Currency field.

CryptoAutoRepayIouOnWithdrawal.description: Lazily repay IOUs on withdrawal: when the player's crypto balance does not cover a withdrawal, the missing part is converted from the player's IOUs of that crypto into real crypto from the players' reward pool of the same network (only as much as needed, while the pool lasts). On by default.

CryptoIouForScriptsAndAI.description: CloudCode server.ApplyResourceOperation and AI feature rewards also grant the unbacked part of a crypto grant as the currency's IOU instead of refusing. Off by default — module rewards (quests, events, leaderboards, store) always use the IOU when the currency has one.

CryptoRewardsFromDeveloperShare.description: Crypto rewards to players that the players' reward pool cannot cover are topped up from the developer's share of the pool. Off by default — the developer turns it on. When off (or the share is short too), the shortfall is granted as the currency's IOU virtual currency (UnbackedRewardCurrencyID).
